verdict.rationale: Maritime's SDK docs describe first-party webhooks: you subscribe a URL and Maritime POSTs a signed JSON body on every agent lifecycle event, which a programmatic consumer can receive instead of polling. The support comes from a single docs excerpt, so its depth is thin. Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog beyond lifecycle events, retry and delivery semantics, signature-verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Subscribe a URL, and Maritime POSTs a signed JSON body on every lifecycle event.
